caveats: Coordinate points are representative location references, not animal positions or polygon boundaries.
A zero is a present standardized category count and may have been added during harmonization; zero is not proof of species absence outside that category and survey window.
A blank source category means no count value recorded and is omitted from long-form exports.
Pup categories aggregate all sexes; the occurrenceID code 3 does not mean source sex was determined to be unknown.
No external taxonomy lookup is performed; scientific names are preserved as source literals.
